strongest_angle: Turkish financial crimes police raided the opposition broadcaster Halk TV in Istanbul, arresting 11 individuals and appointing a government trustee manager amid a sweeping corruption investigation.

key_facts.fact: Turkish financial crimes police raided the Istanbul headquarters of the pro-opposition broadcaster Halk TV, halting live broadcasts and taking 11 people into custody.
Authorities appointed a government trustee manager to oversee Halk TV as part of an ongoing corruption investigation.
The raid on Halk TV occurred in Istanbul just hours before the defense arguments began in the corruption trial of jailed Istanbul mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu and approximately 400 other defendants.
